g.title: OX04
g.text: OX-04 | PROTECT SCENE TRUTH AND UNKNOWN STATES
Behavior board • approved 2026-11-16 • approval and fingerprints in cycle 143 plan

g.title: selected
g.text: The exact selected instant remains authoritative
for reading, composition, foreground, and timeline

g.title: reading
g.text: Each weather field carries its own value, support/evidence,

g.title: independent
g.text: Cloud cover, precipitation amount/rate, snowfall, and
other fields retain their own support and source times.

g.title: probability
g.text: Keep precipitation chance as a chance. It is not a
condition, measured amount, or rainfall rate.

g.title: matrix
g.text: For each fixture-backed state, record input evidence → scene claim →
foreground wording/source time → installed result and limitation.

g.title: supplied
g.text: Do not re-audit supplied weather for plausibility.

g.title: carried
g.text: Only the existing field-specific carry rule may expose
the earlier supplied condition at this selected slot.

g.title: unavailable
g.text: EMPTY · UNSUPPORTED · NOT ELIGIBLE TO CARRY
Do not substitute CLEAR, dry, zero, or another category.

g.title: composition
g.text: One set of typed scene decisions from the same reading
Condition, clouds, precipitation, time cues, and layers

g.title: disclose
g.text: Keep selectedInstant fixed; retain the original

g.title: field_rule
g.text: Preserve only supplied supported values and their
existing scene roles; do not infer a missing field.

g.title: renderer
g.text: The renderer draws composition decisions; it does not
upgrade missing or probability-only evidence into weather.

g.title: foreground
g.text: Show unavailable condition explicitly. Preserve separately
supported facts, source-time disclosure, and exact selection.

g.title: unknown
g.text: With condition unavailable and only independent facts
(such as temperature and precipitation chance), show no
condition-derived weather marks and keep those facts visible.

g.title: exit
g.text: Evidence matrix with fixture-backed evidence plus at least one
visible unknown-state check; record pass, fail, or not run.

g.title: boundary
g.text: No meteorological plausibility correction; no invented field,
zero, or catalog-age threshold; no provider/schema change.
State-only and fixture/Time Lab preview routes stay separate.
